question: Is the one-light view not partisan — how is nondualism yours?
premises: Thus this one light, of the nature of such relishing.
But surely on this view this is partiality: how is nondualism yours?
inference: The one-light relishing-nature draws the partisanship charge against nondualism.
plain_english: Thus this one light, of the nature of such relishing — but surely on this view this is partiality: how is nondualism yours?
